why: Keep the example/integration majority: real subprocess CLI, real sqlite, injected clock, tmp_path isolation, no mocks is house-correct for a local CLI with no HTTP surface. Extend the ALREADY-adopted hypothesis (no new dependency) to the one under-tested security function, util.py's redactor, proven only by one hand-picked example with one of three regexes never exercised. Add syrupy for the dashboard render only checked for non-emptiness. pytest-randomly/xdist are cheap opportunistic adds, not urgent (34s green suite).

alternatives.name: hypothesis
alternatives.covers: Already a dev dependency, already used in 4/44 files for cosine/pass^k/kappa/parent-selection invariants.
alternatives.gap: Not extended to util.py:11-15 SECRET_PATTERNS (3 regexes); only one CLI-subprocess example (test_local_alpha.py:77) exercises it, one pattern untested, no idempotency check.
alternatives.maturity: Mature, actively maintained (HypothesisWorks); already trusted here.

alternatives.name: pytest-xdist
alternatives.covers: Parallel CPU execution; nearly every test already isolates via tmp_path so most are parallel-safe.
alternatives.gap: Not installed. Benefit modest today: 34.41s for 426 tests single-process.
alternatives.cost: Free; PyPI v3.8.0 (2025-07-01, confirmed via pypi.org json).

alternatives.name: pytest-randomly
alternatives.covers: Randomizes order, reseeds random/faker to surface hidden cross-test state.
alternatives.gap: Not installed; no evidence of current order-dependent failures.

alternatives.name: freezegun
alternatives.covers: Freezes datetime.now() for deterministic time tests.
alternatives.gap: No real gap: util.py:18-19 utc_now() is the only live clock call; all time-sensitive tests already inject now_ts as a string, cleaner than monkeypatching.

alternatives.name: syrupy
alternatives.covers: Snapshot-diff testing for generated text/JSON instead of hand assertions.
alternatives.gap: Partial gap: test_tower.py:221-224 only asserts dashboard render is non-empty. Elsewhere targeted field asserts are already clearer than a full snapshot.

alternatives.name: schemathesis
alternatives.covers: Fuzzes requests from an OpenAPI/GraphQL schema against a live API.
alternatives.gap: Everything: no HTTP/GraphQL surface exists (grep repo-wide for FastAPI/Flask/aiohttp found none). Product is a CLI + local sqlite file.
alternatives.maturity: PyPI v4.24.2, maintained, wrong tool class for this surface.

alternatives.name: testcontainers
alternatives.covers: Real disposable Docker containers (Postgres/Redis) for integration tests.
alternatives.gap: Everything: only DB is sqlite3 against a local file, no server, no Docker anywhere in repo.
alternatives.cost: N/A; fights the Windows-11/no-WSL house constraint.
alternatives.maturity: PyPI v4.15.0 (2026-07-24), very active, wrong class here.

evidence: Read test_properties.py, test_archive.py, test_cache.py, test_schema.py, test_tower.py, util.py in full. Ran `uv run pytest -q`: 426 passed/34.41s (quality-contract.json's same-day '3 FAILED' WinError32 note is now stale). grep for hypothesis/subprocess/FastAPI. WebFetch to pypi.org for all 6 alt versions.
recheck: cd intent-control-plane && uv run pytest -q; grep -n SECRET_PATTERNS src/intent_control_plane/util.py; grep -rl hypothesis tests/
migration_loc: +50/-15: new test_redaction_properties.py (~50 lines) trimming one redundant assertion; +15/-5 syrupy snapshot in test_tower.py; xdist/randomly +2 lines in dev deps.
what_ours_does: 44 pytest files, 426 tests (verified: `uv run pytest -q` -> 426 passed in 34.41s). Mostly in-process example tests, no mocks: tmp_path sqlite/JSONL, injected clock strings (test_cache.py). test_local_alpha.py (734 lines) runs the CLI as a real subprocess end-to-end. 4 files already use Hypothesis @given for pure-function invariants (test_properties.py, test_archive.py).
strongest_counterargument: 426/426 green in 34s on a no-money/no-PII/no-prod tool is already strong. The docstrings show the maintainer deliberately chose real-over-mocked and injected-clock-over-frozen-clock -- the harder, better calls these libraries usually shortcut for people who didn't make them. Hand-enumerating the 3 known regex patterns takes 10 minutes without any new dependency.
